title: Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis
abstract: arXiv:2610.38042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. translated_title: 事件检测器能离开转播镜头吗？来自网球运动的证据
translated_abstract: 球的弹跳与球拍击球是网球统计数据赖以生成的事件，而在单目视频中这两者极易混淆。我们发布了一个基准数据集，在混合了转播、固定高位、手机和场地平视视角的八个视频片段上提供345个帧级别的弹跳与击球标注，并配有固定的开发/测试集划分、混淆感知的匹配器、片段级bootstrap置信区间以及对三个片段的盲评二次标注。在该基准上，我们评测了使用已发布转播权重的监督式精确检测器、两个零样本视觉-语言模型，以及RallyArb——一个基于球轨迹与球员姿态构建、不在事件标签上拟合任何参数的仲裁层。监督式检测器在转播画面上得分接近满分，但在手机和场地平视画面上几乎失效，其中E2E-Spot的弹跳F1合并值仅为0.130。RallyArb在三个手机和场地平视视角片段上保持弹跳F1高于0.8，其中两个片段曾用于其调优……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个混合转播、固定高位、手机与场地平视四种视角的网球弹跳/击球事件检测基准，证明现有监督式检测器只对转播画面有效，而基于球轨迹与球员姿态、无需在事件标签上拟合参数的RallyArb仲裁层在手机和场地平视画面上仍能保持弹跳F1高于0.8。
en_tdlr: The paper releases a tennis bounce/hit event detection benchmark spanning broadcast, elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, showing that supervised detectors succeed only on broadcast footage, whereas RallyArb—an arbitration layer over ball tracks and player poses that fits no parameters on event labels—maintains a bounce F1 above 0.8 even on phone and court-level clips.
